@cargie.baby I've been using OneDrive for ages because it was the best value for 1 TB of storage and it comes with Office 365 which is handy sometimes. I think it's about ~$90 CAD annually for me. Microsoft tried to slip in Copilot and increase the price last year, but I was able to get rid of that. Not sure if that's an option for new subscribers though.

There are lots of good reasons to not use OneDrive of course, and I'd rather not have my files with Microsoft, but it still seems hard to beat when it comes to value for money.

Sync.com might be worth checking out. It's not as good value as OneDrive or Dropbox ($144/yr for 1TB), but it's a Canadian company that stores your data in Canada. They claim that everything is encrypted, so hopefully there's no risk of "content violations" like there is with Google Drive and OneDrive.

I'd like to use them TBH, but they seem very determined not to let their service be used for backing up from a NAS, and that's one of my main use cases for cloud storage.

Tape sounds good as new now!
